specs.Camera Lens: Standard lens with 2mm focal length, supporting 18x digital zoom and autofocus capabilities.

features: 4K ULTRA HD VIDEO & 64MP PHOTOS: Capture detailed footage in 4K Ultra HD and high-resolution photos up to 64MP, making the DAC-204 suitable for everyday photography, travel and video recording.
AUTO FOCUS & 18X DIGITAL ZOOM: Equipped with Auto Focus for convenient shooting and an 18X Digital Zoom to bring distant subjects closer while recording.
2.88-INCH LCD DISPLAY: The 2.88-inch LCD screen provides a clear viewing interface for framing shots, reviewing photos and navigating camera functions.
WIFI CONTROL & CREATIVE MODES: Supports WiFi control through the SupCam Pro app and includes useful shooting features such as Slow Motion and Time-Lapse for creative video capture.

RECHARGEABLE BATTERY & STORAGE SUPPORT: Features a 1000mAh rechargeable battery, Type-C charging and supports 64GB to 256GB U3 Micro SD cards for storing photos and videos. Battery life is listed as 4K: 30/90 minutes.
